description: This PHP class extends a Markdown ContentType to generate Confluence-compatible content, including custom JavaScript for rendering MathKTeX and Mermaid diagrams within Confluence pages.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A PHP class that extends Markdown ContentType for Confluence rendering, including custom JavaScript injection for MathKTeX and Mermaid support.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CommonMarkConverter with specific configuration.

methods.name: addJS
methods.description: Returns a string of JavaScript code embedded in Confluence macros for rendering MathKTeX and Mermaid diagrams.

methods.name: doConversion
methods.description: Converts raw Markdown to Confluence-compatible content, appending JavaScript if specific config flags are set.
